# Graceful stop durably cancels owned local work; restart never repeats it.
server start
retry-task task.json hold 1
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id retry-restart
job-id JOB
await-file first
server stop
! stderr .
server start
skygo --json jobs get $JOB
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_CANCELED"'
stdout '"cancel_requested": *true'
history canceled
! exists second
! skygo --json run -f task.json --request-id retry-restart --wait
stdout '"id": *"'$JOB'"'
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_CANCELED"'
stdout '"cancel_requested": *true'
history canceled
! exists second
server stop
! stderr .
